_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/attachments/test_modified_static.py. t_mod_lord is Red XIII, Proud Warrior's middle line alone: other modified creatures you control have vigilance and trample. The modifications are t_eb_aura (an Aura with nothing else), t_plain_gear (an Equipment with nothing else) and a counter; t_eb_bear and t_eb_cub are the vanilla creatures they go on.
